theorem_statement: Among the 144 native ten-cycles sharing the same response through adjacency moment three, the twenty-four registered cycles are exactly those admitting no length-four walk from the cycle to its decagonal antipode. They instead admit exactly twenty length-four walks ending at cycle distance four.
